app.tipSettings: Or configure AI translation service in Settings first
app.deepScanDesc: Deep scan: extract embedded text that regular parsing misses (configs, advancements, guide books, nested jars, code constants)
app.deepScanText: Deep scan text in mod (unchecked by default, included in translation/export after checking):

app.riskDesc: This mod contains deep-scanned embedded text (non-language files, directly in json/config files). Modifying these fields may affect mod behavior.
app.riskCheckedDesc: {count} mods' deep-scanned text included in export. Choose handling:

app.includeDeep: Include deep scan text (may have risk)
app.noTranslations: Nothing to export: no "translated" entry is selected. Please confirm: ① the entries to export are checked; ② their translation status is not red (failed).
app.riskOk: Skip deep scan text, export language files only (recommended)
app.riskWarn: Include deep scan text (may have risk)
app.chooseDir: Select directory (generate {count} translated jars, no overwrite)
app.chooseDirPack: Select export directory (generate mods_zh_cn.zip merged resource pack)
app.chooseDirShader: Select export directory (generate translated shader pack)
app.jarExport: Select directory (will generate translated jar, no overwrite)

app.glossaryModalDesc: Select which prompt segment to edit (editable segments are open, core segments are system-preserved):
app.packSettingsDesc: Single pack settings: resource pack format, merged name, export path, whether to export jar
app.packNameDesc: Generated resource pack name prefix, e.g. "Mods_Zh_CN", resulting in {name}.zip
app.exportJarDesc: Whether to generate an independent translated jar for this mod (preserves original file, writes translated content to zh_cn.json or hardcoded locations).
app.exportPathDesc: Export jar or shader pack to specified directory (generates new file with timestamp if not overwriting).
app.exportJarPathDesc: Export translated jar to specified directory (generates new file if not overwriting).
app.alertEmpty: {empty} entries returned no translation. Suggestions: ① reduce "Batch Size" in Settings and re-translate these entries; ② switch to a more stable model.
app.alertError429: {error} entries failed due to API rate limiting (429). Suggestions: increase "Request Interval" or lower "Thread Count" in Settings, or retry later.
app.alertErrorOther: {error} entries failed (marked red). Mostly network errors or invalid key/model config. Check your API Key and model name in "Settings" and retry.
app.alertWarn: {warn} entries have placeholder/format validation warnings (orange tags). Verify %s, § codes are intact before export to avoid in-game display issues.
app.alertInfo: No new translations in this batch.
app.msgApiKeyRequired: An API Key is required to translate. Click "Settings" (top-right) → "Provider & Model", enter your API Key and translate again.
app.msgParseCorrupt: "{name}" read failed: the file may be corrupted, locked by another program, or not a valid archive. Re-download it or close programs using it, then retry.
app.msgParseNotPack: "{name}" is not recognized as translatable content: it is neither a standard mod nor a resource/shader pack, or contains no translatable text. Verify the file source, or try "Deep Scan" on the mod.
app.msgNoExportItem: "{name}" has no translatable entries to export: no "checked and translated" entries under this mod, skipped.
app.msgSettingsLoadFailed: Failed to load settings, using defaults. You can adjust them in "Settings".
app.noExportItem: No translatable entries among the selected ones
app.clickSelectPlugin: Click to choose or drop a plugin jar
app.pluginDesc: Supports Bukkit / Spigot / Paper / BungeeCord / Velocity plugins; parses plugin.yml and message configs (yml / properties / json), filters internal keys like database settings; deep scan extracts hardcoded text
app.aiNameNoKey: No API key or model configured — {n} pack(s) will fall back to Original_zh_cn
app.aiNamePartial: AI name generation failed for {n} pack(s); fell back to Original_zh_cn
app.aiNameFailed: AI name generation failed for {n} pack(s) — falling back to Original_zh_cn. Reason: {reason}
app.deepScanPopoverHint: Click to scan with current rules; use the gear to tune rules for this pack
app.deepScanTooltip: Extracts embedded text a normal scan may miss: config files, advancements, manuals, nested jars, and hardcoded strings in the .class constant pool (player-visible messages, GUI titles, item names…). Noisy for mods, so it is off by default — enable it in Deep scan → Mod rules.

provider.groupDesc: Each provider keeps its own API key and model choice — switching providers never mixes configs
provider.label: Provider

provider.modelPlaceholderCustom: Pick or type a model name

provider.hintDoubao: Doubao: use a model ID, or an endpoint ID created in the Volcano Ark console (ep- prefix)
provider.hintMoonshot: Kimi: models iterate fast — click "Fetch models" to see what's available
provider.hintOpenai: OpenAI: access from mainland China can be unstable; a proxy may be needed
provider.hintOpenrouter: OpenRouter: one key for every platform; model IDs carry vendor prefixes (e.g. google/gemini-2.5-flash)
provider.hintCustom: Custom: any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Base URL + model name)

params.groupDesc: Lower temperature gives steadier output; batch size affects request size and streaming granularity
params.batchSizeAutoTooltip: When on, batch size = entries to translate / threads (rounded up) for full-thread throughput. Note: with few entries or many similar items in one batch (e.g. lots of alike config keys), the model may return the source text unchanged ("translation identical to source"); if that happens you'll be asked whether to clear and re-translate
params.batchSizeTooltip: Entries per request (1-200); translations are streamed batch by batch

glossary.groupDesc: Unify terms and style: the glossary locks proper-noun translations, prompts define the translator role and rules
glossary.extractTooltip: Before translating, let the AI extract a glossary of proper nouns from the entries to unify translations
glossary.customDescTip: Format: English → Chinese, e.g. Diamond → 钻石
glossary.customDesc: Custom glossary (unify terms, e.g. Diamond → 钻石; format: English → Chinese)
glossary.empty: No custom terms yet — add one with the button below

threading.warn: Parallel requests are more likely to hit provider rate limits (429); the app backs off and retries automatically. Pick threads and intervals based on your provider's limits — longer intervals are safer.
threading.intervalTooltip: Gap between requests within each thread — longer gaps are less likely to trigger rate limits
threading.deepScanTooltip: Extracts embedded text a normal scan may miss: config files, advancements, manuals, nested jars, and hardcoded strings in the compiled .class constant pool (player-visible messages, GUI titles, item names…). Noisy for mods, so it is off by default — enable it in the deep-scan rules.
threading.deepScanDesc: When on, mods whose normal parse is empty automatically get a deep scan; you can also click "Deep scan" on a mod card
threading.packWarn: Translating several packs at once multiplies concurrency and makes rate limiting much more likely; all packs also share the per-thread request quota. Choose the pack count based on your provider's limits.

appearance.groupDesc: Export naming and close behavior are independent and apply on save
appearance.closeBehaviorTip: "Minimize to tray": the close button only hides the window — restore or exit from the tray icon; your pack list and progress are kept
appearance.exportNamingTip: How exported files are named. Original = same name as the source file (no suffix); Original_zh_cn = source name plus a localization suffix; AI name = ask the model for a Chinese name during translation (small extra token cost), falling back to Original_zh_cn when unavailable.
appearance.deepScanModTip: Extract embedded text a regular parse may miss: configs, advancements, manuals, nested jars, plus hardcoded strings in the .class constant pool (off by default; enable it in the deep-scan rules).
appearance.deepScanPluginTip: Extract text that regular parsing may miss: message configs, command/permission descriptions, plus hardcoded strings in the .class constant pool (chat prefixes, GUI titles, scoreboards).
appearance.deepScanHint: When enabled, packs with no text found during import are scanned automatically; you can also click "Deep scan" on a card manually

deepScan.autoHint: When on, packs that yield no text on import are scanned automatically
deepScan.missingRules: Deep-scan rules are missing in settings. Reopen settings and retry.
deepScan.packFollowGlobal: Pack override cleared; now following global rules
deepScan.packScopeHint: Applies to this pack only. The master switch and custom rules live in Settings → Personalization.
deepScan.packSaved: Rules saved for this pack (applies after re-scan)
deepScan.fixedNote: Fixed: nesting depth 3 and text length 3-200 are enforced by the engine

desc.scopeJson: Text inside advancements, recipes and configs. Low noise, high value.
desc.scopeLang: .lang and .properties outside assets/lang (common in plugins). High value.
desc.scopeText: toml/ini/cfg/conf/yaml/yml/txt/md. Configs are valuable; txt/md docs add noise.
desc.scopeNested: Jars inside jars (jar-in-jar mods). Valuable, but bundled library text comes too.
desc.scopeClass: Parse hardcoded strings in the .class constant pool (player-visible messages, GUI titles, item names…); the main source of plugin messages, off by default for mods because of noise.
desc.skipMeta: META-INF, LICENSE, CHANGELOG and similar untranslatable content.
desc.skipLangfiles: Language files are handled by the normal parser; re-scanning duplicates entries, so this stays on.
desc.skipLibs: Skips bundled third-party libraries (bukkit/json/google/kotlin...) - about 8% pure noise removed in tests.
desc.onlySourceLocale: In multi-locale packs only English/Chinese count as source; other locales go to an unchecked group so German/Japanese is never treated as source.
desc.keepCjk: Any text containing Chinese is kept, protecting existing translations. Always on.
desc.dropSql: Strings starting with SQL keywords or containing SQL clauses (typical in data stores).
desc.dropDescriptor: JVM internals such as Lcom/a/B; or (Ljava/lang/String;)V.
desc.dropLog: Console-oriented lines (Failed / Could not / Loading / stack traces) rather than player-facing text.
desc.dropIdent: Keys, permission nodes and constants without spaces (e.g. griefprevention.claim.kick).
desc.classNeedsMarker: When on, code strings with color codes/placeholders or sentence shape go to "Messages" (checked by default); the rest go to "Code - other" (unchecked).

deepScan.customEmpty: No custom rules yet. Add an extension / glob / regex, or import a community profile.
deepScan.customReadOnly: For a single pack you can only tick the custom rules already defined in Settings; add, import or edit them in Settings → Deep scan.
deepScan.testHint: Pick or import a pack to preview the scan result with the current rules.
deepScan.testNote: The testbed uses the same engine and rules as real scans and follows the **current toggles in this dialog** — flips re-run instantly, no need to save first. Up to 30 samples are shown.
deepScan.testNoteTip: Same rules and parser; follows the current toggles — what you see is what a real scan gets
deepScan.groupDesc: Deep scan digs out embedded text beyond normal parsing (advancements, configs, code constants). Mods and plugins are configured separately; every rule can be toggled.
deepScan.groupHintTip: Uses the "Recommended" template: noisy rules off, message text pre-checked. Changes apply to later scans only.
deepScan.groupHint: The "Recommended" template is active by default: noisy rules are off and high-confidence message text is pre-checked. Switch to "Everything (legacy)" to restore the old behaviour. Rule changes apply to later scans; re-click the scan button on a pack to re-scan (existing translations are preserved).
deepScan.customEmptyPack: No custom rules to tick for this pack. Add or import them in Settings → Deep scan.

storage.title: Local data
storage.desc: Only this app's own data folders are counted. Game folders, export folders and other apps' files are never touched.
storage.clearCacheDesc: Deletes: the last pack-list snapshot, the game-directory scan cache (this is what avoids re-scanning after a restart, so the next scan will run again) and the browser page cache. Settings, API key and exported files are untouched.
storage.clearDataDesc: Deletes: API key and all settings (provider, model, translation params, deep-scan rules, glossary, AI name cache), the last pack list, and the browser profile/cache.
storage.confirmTitle: Do you know what you are doing?
storage.confirmDesc: This is the final step and cannot be undone: you will have to enter the API key and all settings again.
storage.ack: I understand: delete all the data above, irreversibly
storage.skipped: {n} item(s) were in use and skipped; clear again after closing the app
storage.restartDesc: Settings and browser profile were reset to defaults; a restart makes it fully effective.
storage.restartFailed: Restart failed, please close and reopen the app manually
storage.willDelete: The following data will be deleted
